applicable_when: The kernel launches 3,920 CTAs across 132 SMs (1.86 waves), with a partial wave of 1,808 blocks that NCU estimates accounts for up to 50% of runtime. Each CTA processes only 128 elements (trivial work), so launch overhead and wave-tail waste dominate the 4.74 us runtime. Warps stall 78% of cycles on L1TEX with no other warps eligible to fill the pipeline. Prior attempts to fix this by increasing XBLOCK all failed correctness because the index decomposition (x0 = xindex % 64, x1 = xindex // 64) is tightly coupled to the 64-element input row width. The safe alternative is a persistent kernel: launch exactly num_sms=132 CTAs, and have each CTA iterate over multiple tiles in a loop. This eliminates the partial wave entirely, keeps XBLOCK=128 (preserving correctness), and amortizes launch overhead across all tiles processed per SM.
